categories.main_business_segments: Shandong New Jufeng Technology Packaging Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of aseptic packaging materials. Its main products include roll-type aseptic packaging used mainly for liquid dairy products and non-carbonated soft drinks. The company also operates subsidiaries involved in packaging material production, trade, and aseptic filling equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced roll-type aseptic packaging technology, including flexographic printing, composite material lamination, and solvent-free water-based ink systems. It employs automated and intelligent production lines with real-time quality monitoring and closed pneumatic conveying systems for raw materials. The company holds over 28 core patents related to printing, lamination, adhesion, surface treatment, and variable printing technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic liquid dairy producers such as Yili, New Hope, and Sanyuan, as well as non-carbonated soft drink manufacturers like Wanglaoji and Jiaduobao. The products serve the liquid dairy and non-carbonated beverage markets, including juice, tea drinks, functional drinks, and plant-based beverages. The company maintains long-term stable relationships with these major customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are primarily domestic within China, with production facilities in Shandong Province and sales focused on the Chinese market. It also has overseas subsidiaries in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Switzerland, supporting international trade and investment activities. The company is exploring international market expansion opportunities.
categories.supply_chain_position: New Jufeng operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of aseptic packaging materials that are supplied to downstream liquid food and beverage producers. It procures raw materials such as base paper, aluminum foil, and polyethylene from upstream suppliers and delivers finished packaging products to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes product innovation, digital transformation, and capacity expansion. It is investing in a new R&D center in Kunshan to enhance technological capabilities and accelerate industry advancements. Strategic priorities include improving production efficiency, developing new packaging types and sizes, and promoting domestic substitution of foreign packaging materials and equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aseptic packaging products to liquid dairy and non-carbonated beverage manufacturers. The company operates on an order-based production model, with annual framework contracts and direct sales channels. It also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the roll-type aseptic packaging market, holding approximately 10.5% market share in China’s aseptic packaging sales volume and 13.4% share in the liquid dairy aseptic packaging segment. It competes with international giants like Tetra Pak and SIG but is gaining ground through technological improvements and domestic substitution efforts.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.7 billion, a slight decrease of 1.79% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders increasing by 8.03% to about RMB 184 million. The company has steadily expanded production capacity and improved profitability despite market pressures, supported by strong cash flow generation and ongoing capital investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: New Jufeng emphasizes high-quality, stable, and customized aseptic packaging solutions that meet stringent food safety and shelf-life requirements. Its competitive advantages include advanced production technology, comprehensive after-sales technical support, and a strong focus on environmental sustainability with FSC-certified materials and eco-friendly inks. The company’s ability to provide tailored packaging designs and maintain long-term customer partnerships differentiates it in the market.
